To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.AI EngineerAbout The RoleLenovo is seeking a motivated and innovative AI Engineer to support the development and implementation of AI-powered solutions that improve business processes, increase efficiency, and drive digital transformation. This role focuses on leveraging Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and intelligent automation to enhance business operations and employee experiences.What You'll DoAI Development: Design, develop, and implement AI/ML and Generative AI solutions to address business challenges.Process Automation: Support the implementation of Intelligent Process Automation (IPA), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), and workflow automation solutions.Application Development: Build and deploy AI applications, intelligent agents, models, and data pipelines.Business Transformation: Collaborate with business and technology teams to identify opportunities for AI-driven innovation and process improvement.System Integration: Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, data platforms, and existing business systems.Performance Optimization: Monitor and improve AI solutions to enhance accuracy, reliability, and efficiency.Innovation: Explore emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to improve productivity and business operations.What We're Looking ForRequired QualificationsBachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.Entry-level position; 0–2 years of relevant experience. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply.Foundational knowledge of Python programming and AI/ML concepts.Familiarity with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI applications.Basic understanding of APIs, data pipelines, and software development principles.Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.Preferred QualificationsInternship, academic project, or research experience involving AI/ML development.Familiarity with TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain, or similar frameworks.Exposure to RPA tools, workflow automation, or AI agents.Basic knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.Experience with AI projects, automation solutions, or process improvement initiatives.We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.
